profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer eager to collaborate and explore new opportunities in the field. Visit my website to view my portfolio and find additional details, including my contact information.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an integration with an external coupon provider (AppCard Super J) for shopping cart evaluation using Ruby and PostgreSQL

• Diagnosed and resolved 8+ recurring production defects in NCR's FedRAMP-compliant transaction-log pipeline for DeCA military commissary stores, including a duplicate promotion bug overcharging customers $160/order and a silent XML validation failure that dropped audit records without raising an error

• Resolved 10 client support tickets per month, including high-priority issues with third-party integrations (Uber, Mailgun, Fiserv)

• Built an AI agent orchestrator that guides engineers from a JIRA ticket through requirements, design, implementation, and testing; adopted team-wide, increasing per engineer ticket throughput by 3 per sprin

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Software developer for a government library application. Contributed to feature development, bug fixes, and testing using JUnit, Jasmine / Karma in Angular. Docker, Java Spring, Java Web Start, Java Tiles/Struts, Java Server Pages, AngularJS, PostgreSQL and Gradle

• Led the development and conducted research on middleware integration within cloud API services, crafting packages and libraries within Flask for Python, implementing Java Interceptors and filters for Spring, and creating npm modules in JavaScript for Express.

• Developed Access Control Model System integration for Cloud API Keycloak authentication with LDAP, Docker, and Java

• Utilized Liquibase to automate the creation of schemas within the PostgreSQL database as part of the Keycloak authentication framework

positions.title: Associate Application Developer
positions.description:
• Developed Compliance Proof of Concept Service using a rule engine to check pay statements against state specific compliance requirements using AWS, Spring Boot, and Drools rule engine.

• Recorded functional requirements documentation for Compliance as a Service

• Configured state specific requirements for compliance service together with Product Owner and relevant business units 

• Assisted in developing state specific requirements into code within Compliance as a Service using AWS Lambdas, S3, RDS and Drools rule engine.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Java and +1 skill
